notes.title: THE ZIBBO SHOW: UPDATE 1.1.0 IS HERE!

items.text: [p align="justify"]

Ladies and gentlemen, contestants and future victims! Zibbo has some big news for you. We've been listening to your feedback, keeping a close eye on the show, and working behind the scenes to make every round feel better. There are new ways to shape your strategy, a few welcome changes to the Zibbo Shop, and some quality-of-life improvements to make your time in the spotlight even smoother. Ready to see what's changed? Let's roll!
[p align="justify"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46071701/a00ae1c4b09ef0c29547fcfb3a25ffce22735dc4.png"]
ECONOMY & BALANCING
[p align="justify"]Zibbo believes in giving everyone a fair chance... well, more or less. Here's how the odds and the shop have changed.
Enemy behaviour: Enemy behaviour is now more consistent with their builds. Don't expect everyone the same way every time!
[p align="justify"]Bosses and enemies balance: Bosses and enemies balance: Some bosses and some enemies have been rebalanced.

[p align="justify"]A better opening hand: We’ve revised the cards available at the beginning of a run to offer a wider variety of options during the early rounds and give you more flexibility when building your strategy.
[p align="justify"]More starting money: You'll begin each run with a little more cash, giving you more room to adapt when luck doesn't go your way.
[p align="justify"] Sell your chips: You can now sell chips to make room for a different strategy or save money for something tempting in the Zibbo Shop. The choice is yours.
[p align="justify"]An extra “Roll Again” chip: You'll now get an additional “Roll Again” chip in Round 1. A little help never hurts when the cameras are rolling.
[p align="justify"]More cards in the shop: Zibbo’s Shop now offers one additional card to purchase, giving you one more option to consider before the next round.
[p align="justify"]Shop discount after winning the roulette: If you win at the Spin of Luck, you’ll get a temporary discount on chips and cards in Zibbo’s Shop. Make the most of it!
[p align="justify"]More Roll Again chips in the shop: Roll Again chips can now appear as infinite stock in the Zibbo Shop, so you may be able to pick up more when you need them.
[p align="justify"]Roll Again chip price: The Roll Again chip is now cheaper. Go on, give those dice another chance.
[p align="justify"]Better Spin of Luck odds: Your chances of winning have been increased. When you are forced to take a spin, the odds are a little more in your favour.
[p align="justify"]Spin and Win chip: This chip costs a little more now.
[p align="justify"]Spin of Luck tickets: Tickets are a little more expensive. The Spin of Luck is now a more considered choice, and the improved odds make taking that chance feel more rewarding.
[p align="justify"]GAMEPLAY & NEW FEATURES
[p align="justify"]The show must go on, and now you have a few more ways to plan your next move.
[p align="justify"]A preview of what’s to come: The shop now gives you a heads-up about the boss appearing in upcoming rounds, so you can prepare your strategy before they take the stage.

[p align="justify"]New Infinite Mode enemies: We've added new opponents to Infinite Mode. Some of you have been putting up seriously impressive scores, so The System has been digging through its database to find fresh challengers. Think you can beat them?
[p align="justify"]BUG FIXES
[p align="justify"]Even The System has to fix a few things from time to time.

[p align="justify"]The Prince of Chance: There was an issue in The System. This card now activates only when you're not already in an extra turn and grants two extra turns, preventing it from almost filling the whole board in a single turn. See? We're not that evil.

[p align="justify"]Windowed mode crash: Fixed a crash that could occur when switching to windowed mode while using two monitors with different resolutions.: Fixed a bug where some card sets didn't unlock despite the unlocking of their corresponding achievement.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS
[p align="justify"]A few thoughtful tweaks to make the show run at your pace. The devil is in the details!
[p align="justify"]Choose your game speed: You can now play at x1, x1.5, x2, or x3 speed. Pick the pace that suits you. This option is unavailable during the tutorial.

[p align="justify"]Skip ahead automatically: There's a new option to automatically skip dialogue and the New Game cutscene. You can find it in the options menu. This option is unavailable during the tutorial. You asked for it, we delivered!
[p align="justify"]Frame rate limit: A new option lets you set your preferred frame rate limit.
[p align="justify"]A smoother Spin of Luck restart: We've added a Surrender button to the Spin of Luck, making it quicker to restart the round when you decide to call it.
[p align="justify"]Round earnings summary: After winning a round, you'll now see the total amount of money you've earned during it. Every coin counts!
[p align="justify"]NEW STORY CONTENT
[p align="justify"]You thought that was the end of the show? Not so fast, contestant. There's still more to uncover about who's really pulling the strings.
[p align="justify"]A new ending video: Beat the game to unlock a new video revealing more lore about the Show. You can watch it from the main menu.
[p align="justify"]SOUND & LOCALIZATION
[p align="justify"]A little more polish for your time in the spotlight.
[p align="justify"]The show's soundtrack: Music tracks now loop less often, bringing a little more variety to the show's soundtrack.
More complete localization: We've added translations so no contestant gets left wondering what just happened.

[p align="justify"]That's all for this update, contestants. And remember, we're always looking for ways to make the show even better. Got feedback, ideas, or balance suggestions? Come share them with us on Discord!
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]More ways to play, more ways to create crazy combos and more chances to survive.
[p align="justify"]Remember: Zibbo is always watching.
We've uploaded a patch, specially important for people who plays between Steam Deck and PC, these are the notes:
Cloud-saves between Steam Deck and PC are now fixed.
Now in the shop a text saying "Buy now!" appears.
Minor text fixes.
Hope you are enjoying the show so far!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46071701/45977ebfb986fd1df1d9c82235ae34f1ec84e5b6.png"]
We’ve updated the demo with many improvements, balance adjustments, and new languages. Here is the complete list of changes:
New languages have been added: Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Russian, Swedish, and Turkish.
The boss from the previous demo has been replaced with a new one. Now you’ll face a fresh challenge!
We’ve made improvements to gameplay and the user experience when using a controller.
The “Roll Again” chip now never rolls the same number as the previous roll. This is to minimize the penalty from RNG.
You can now sell cards in the shop. This adds a layer of complexity to the economy and allows you to rework your builds between rounds if needed… or just for fun!
The boss in each round now goes first.
In response to your feedback, you can now skip the game over sequence.
New intro and shop videos have been added to the tutorial. This was done to make the tutorial more enjoyable and shorter.
Text adjustments have been made in all languages.
We’ve added new cards. Do you dare to try them all?
New visual effects have been added to boss cards.
Adjustments have been made to enemy balancing.
The cards have been rebalanced to make them fairer.
Now, if you don’t bet, you’ll receive some money. For the inconvenience of being forced to… I mean, because I’m a generous person.
Sounds have been added and the overall sound design has been improved.
Visual, stability, and performance improvements.
Bugs and crash fixes.
Oh, and by the way, you can also try the demo on Steam Deck! You can even use the touch controls if that’s more comfortable for you ;)
We invite you to join The Zibbo Show again, we hope both current and new contestants will enjoy it.
NOTE: To ensure a smooth experience, we recommend deleting any previous save games from the demo. To do this, delete the entire folder %localappdata%\\TheZibboShow\\Saved\\SaveGames.
